guitar.guitaristsText: Dave Murray / Adrian Smith / Janick Gers
guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Murray & Smith signature models) / Gibson Les Paul (Gers)
guitar.evidence: Dave Murray and Adrian Smith both have Fender Stratocaster signature models; well documented for a 3-guitarist lineup.

tone.target: bright NWOBHM Marshall crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: bright NWOBHM Marshall crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A tight, aggressive rhythm tone built around the UK 45 amp model, utilizing a Boost for attack and Chorus sparingly for subtle width, paired with a dry cab and moderate compression.

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in aggressive rhythm playing.
Enhance pick attack and upper-mid bite for aggressive rhythm playing.
Provide the classic Marshall/Plexi crunch and upper-mid bite without excessive fuzz.
Simulate the classic British Marshall/Plexi voicing required for NWOBHM.
Provide the required classic British cabinet voicing and presence.
Achieve tight palm-muting and sustain for aggressive rhythm playing.
Sharpen the upper-mids and boost bite while keeping the tone dry.
Add subtle width and dimension without sounding like a big effect (used sparingly).
blocks.gap: The Chorus is generally avoided, but a very low mix helps add necessary air/width.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal amount of natural ambience to keep the tone dry but not sterile.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to enhance upper-mid bite and presence, crucial for NWOBHM aggression.

proposals.reason: Boosts upper-mids and presence needed for aggressive rhythm tone.
